```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(gt)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
read.tb <- function(path, method) {
  files <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE, pattern = 'stram.csv')
  tb <- map_dfr(files, function(x) {data.frame(method = method,
                                               sample = str_remove(basename(x), '_stram.csv'),
                                               fread(x))})
  return(tb)
}
```


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
result <- bind_rows(read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm/compleasm/', 's.13.a'),
                    read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm-10kb/compleasm/', 's.13.b'),
                    read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm/purge_dups/compleasm/', 's.13.c'),
                    read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm-10kb/purge_dups/compleasm/', 's.13.d'),
                    read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm/fcs-gx/purge_dups/compleasm/', 's.13.e'),
                    read.tb('~/project_data/downy/hifiasm-10kb/fcs-gx/purge_dups/compleasm/', 's.13.f'))
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
result %>% group_by(sample) %>% gt()
```
